evals.name: blank-input
evals.prompt: Test the initial Add author dialog state before submitting a name.
evals.expected_output: Locate the real controls and assert Add is disabled.
assertions: Opens the dialog through Add author.
Selects Add by its exact accessible name.
Checks that submission is disabled before entering a name.

evals.name: local-story
evals.prompt: A setter spy passes even when the Library dialog never updates. Fix the story check.
assertions: Performs and awaits the user's interaction.
Asserts the visible result rather than a spy or screenshot.

evals.name: real-row
evals.prompt: Show that registration reaches the open authors list.
evals.expected_output: Drive a running application journey rather than a local story.
assertions: Uses a unique disposable author name with no initial matching row.
Awaits the matching row without reloading.
